items.title: AI Ate My Velociraptor
items.summary: Introducing velociraptor-skills, a set of reusable AI skills for DFIR with Velociraptor.

items.title: Iranopasmigirim - Unmasking an ever-evolving Espionage Campaign Against Iranian Dissidents - Part 1
items.summary: In this article, we summarise our findings on a previously unknown Threat Actor targeting internal dissidents, connected to the “Rise Iran!” movement. We highlight the lures used, insights into the deployed InfoStealer we call ParsaStealer, and further insights into the Telegram channels used.

items.title: 22 CVEs in TeamDavid® a "secure" M365 alternative
items.summary: One pentest turned into 22 CVEs in TeamDavid®, a self-hosted "secure" Microsoft 365 alternative, from an unauthenticated single-request DoS to full, unauthenticated account takeover.

items.title: Anatomy of a Deno-Based Proxy & RAT
items.summary: Analysis of a Deno-based malware intrusion that began with mailbombing and a fake Microsoft Teams IT-support call, leading a victim to execute a malicious archive. The payload is a modular JavaScript RAT/proxy framework using Deno, with components for C2 over WebSocket, local command execution, persistence, and TCP tunneling for internal pivoting.

items.title: Ghost-Sender - Universal Email Spoofing against Exchange Online
items.summary: An analysis of a widely available Exchange Online misconfiguration allowing attackers to spoof internal and external senders.

items.title: SeppMail Secure E-Mail Gateway: Critical RCE and LFI Vulnerabilities
items.summary: A widely used Secure E-Mail Gateway "SeppMail" revealed critical vulnerabilities with little effort and without chaining of multiple vulnerabilities. RCE to compromise the device, LFI to read mails and more. (CVE-2026-2743, CVE-2026-7864, CVE-2026-44127, CVE-2026-44128)

items.title: BravoX - The new Kids on the Block
items.summary: This article provides an overview of BravoX, a new ransomware player whose operations combine familiar tactics with a few distinctive twists, offering insight into their techniques, tooling, and notably their negotiation approach.

items.title: Slithering Through the Noise - Deep Dive into the VIPERTUNNEL Python Backdoor
items.summary: This article provides a comprehensive summary of our research into the VIPERTUNNEL Python backdoor, including infrastructure hunting and showcasing the evolution of the code.

items.title: Decrypting and Abusing Predefined BIOCs in Palo Alto Cortex XDR
items.summary: The Behavioral Indicators of Compromise (BIOCs) of Cortex XDR contain numerous exceptions, including global whitelists that can be abused to evade detection even when using simple and well-known TTPs.

items.title: Abusing Cortex XDR Live Terminal as a C2
items.summary: The Cortex XDR agent includes an incident response feature called "Live Terminal", which attackers can abuse as a C2.
